senses.gloss:
nairātmyavāda
(‘school of philosophy that does not admit of आत्मन् or a permanent सोउल्’)
------------------------------------------
Certain schools of इन्दिअन् फिलोसोफ्य् like the Cārvāka and the Bauddha, do not subscribe to the view that there is a permanent reality called आत्मन्, behind our body-मिन्द् complex, that survives death. The arguments and philosophy of such schools are designated as ‘nairātmyavāda’.
See also CĀRVĀKADARŚANA.
